name: electron-jupyter-sandbox
description: 完全隔離型・AI連携デスクトップJupyter環境

scripts.test:unit: npm run set-policy:strict && node --test tests/config.test.js tests/server.test.js tests/security.test.js tests/logger.test.js tests/settings.test.js tests/policy.test.js tests/prompt.test.js tests/contents-api.test.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:wheels
scripts.build:ext: npm run --workspace=@electron-jupyter-sandbox/ai-copy-extension build && npm run --workspace=@electron-jupyter-sandbox/preload-extension build && npm run --workspace=@electron-jupyter-sandbox/host-drive-extension build
scripts.build:jupyter: uv run jupyter lite build --config jupyter_lite_config.json
scripts.build: npm run build:ext && npm run build:jupyter
scripts.set-policy:strict: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('./src/policy.json', JSON.stringify({ configurable: false }, null, 2) + '\n')"
scripts.set-policy:configurable: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('./src/policy.json', JSON.stringify({ configurable: true }, null, 2) + '\n')"
scripts.package:linux: npm run set-policy:strict && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
